components: Traffic enters through multiple geographically separate regions.
One aggregate policy defines the total permitted rate.
The global budget is divided into regional leases or synchronized state.
Regions spend local allocations without cross-region checks per request.
Allocations shift as demand changes while bounding aggregate overshoot.
